# A submit whose reply is lost is replayed only by an explicit resume,
# with the stored request; the server holds one job. A Begin whose reply
# is lost holds the job: no second Begin and no submit.

skygo-ec2 start -config $CONFIG -state $STATE -credentials $CREDS -interval 0
code 0

lose SubmitWorkspaceJob 1
! job run -job $WORK/job -task $WORK/task.json -workdir $WORK/src -poll 100ms
code 1
stdout '"upload": "finalized"'
stdout '"submit": "sent"'
! stdout '"job_id"'
stderr 'replay only with resume'
calls SubmitWorkspaceJob 1
jobs 1

# job-status cannot look up a job whose ID is unknown, and never submits:
# it prints the stored status without an EC2 call or a session.
opens 1
ec2mark
job job-status -job $WORK/job
code 0
stdout '"submit": "sent"'
! stdout '"job_id"'
calls SubmitWorkspaceJob 1

# logs has no job to read, which the journal alone decides.
! job logs -job $WORK/job
code 1
stderr 'no job ID is known'
ec2since 0
opens 1

job resume -job $WORK/job -poll 100ms
code 0
stdout '"state": "SUCCEEDED"'
stdout '"output": "saved"'
calls SubmitWorkspaceJob 2
accepted BeginArtifactUpload 1
jobs 1
output $WORK/job out/result.txt input

# A lost chunk reply: resume reconciles the offset and sends each chunk
# once. The workdir is more than two chunks; the second reply is lost.
blob $WORK/big/blob 150000
lose WriteArtifactChunk 2
! job run -job $WORK/chunk -task $WORK/task.json -workdir $WORK/big -poll 100ms
code 1
stdout '"upload": "open"'
stdout '"acknowledged": 65536,'
job resume -job $WORK/chunk -poll 100ms
code 0
stdout '"state": "SUCCEEDED"'
calls GetArtifactUpload 1
jobs 2

# A lost Begin reply holds the job, latched across commands. resume of
# the held job is refused before any EC2 call or session.
lose BeginArtifactUpload 1
! job run -job $WORK/held -task $WORK/task.json -workdir $WORK/src
code 5
stdout '"hold": "upload-begin-outcome-unknown"'
opens 5
rawmark BeginArtifactUpload
ec2mark
! job resume -job $WORK/held
code 5
stdout '"hold": "upload-begin-outcome-unknown"'
ec2since 0
opens 5
accepted BeginArtifactUpload 3
rawsince BeginArtifactUpload 0
calls SubmitWorkspaceJob 3
jobs 2

mutations 1

-- task.json --
{"argv":["/bin/sh","-c","cat input.txt >out/result.txt"],"setup":["/bin/sh","-c","mkdir out"],"outputs":["out"],"timeoutSeconds":"60"}
-- src/input.txt --
input
-- big/input.txt --
input
